name: Stuffed Mushrooms
description: A savory appetizer of mushroom caps filled with a creamy mixture of bacon, cream cheese, and Parmesan.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the crumbled bacon, cream cheese, Parmesan cheese, and Worcestershire sauce together.
Stuff the mixture into the mushroom caps.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

keywords: stuffed mushrooms, appetizer, bacon, cream cheese

_similar.name: Crab-Stuffed Mushrooms
_similar.description: A savory appetizer featuring large mushrooms filled with a crab meat and cheese mixture, baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup grated Emmenthal or Gruyère cheese, divided

recipeInstructions.text: Wipe mushrooms with lemon juice. Remove stems for stuffing and set caps aside.
Trim and chop stems. In a saucepan, melt butter. Add onion and chopped mushroom stems. Cook until mushroom stems are tender and moisture has evaporated.
Stir in drained crab meat, 1/4 cup cheese, 1 tablespoon cracker crumbs, mayonnaise, salt, and pepper to taste. Mix well.
Spoon stuffing into mushroom caps and place on greased baking dish.
Combine remaining 1/4 cup cheese and 1 teaspoon cracker crumbs. Sprinkle evenly over stuffed mushrooms.
Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Bake in 400°F oven for 10 to 12 minutes. Serve hot.

_similar.name: Mushroom Soup
_similar.description: A creamy mushroom soup made with sautéed mushrooms, onions, and garlic in a rich milk-based broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute butter, onion, garlic and mushrooms.
Add flour and stir together.
Add stock, sauces and milk.
Simmer until heated through (approximately 15 minutes).
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: mushroom soup, creamy soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Cheddar Baked Potato Slices
_similar.description: Thinly sliced baking potatoes baked with cheddar cheese and a creamy mushroom soup sauce.
recipeIngredient: 4 medium baking potatoes, cut into ¼ inch slices

recipeInstructions.text: In a small bowl, combine cream of mushroom soup, paprika, and pepper.
Arrange potato slices in overlapping rows in a greased 2-quart oblong baking dish.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the potatoes.
Spoon the soup mixture evenly over the cheese.
Cover the dish with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes.
Uncover and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until potatoes are fork-tender.

_similar.keywords: baked potatoes, cheddar cheese, creamy sauce

_similar.name: Stuffing and Chicken
_similar.description: A comforting chicken breast casserole with Stove Top stuffing, Swiss cheese, and cream of chicken soup.
recipeIngredient: 4 boned and skinned chicken breast halves

recipeInstructions.text: Place chicken breasts in a sprayed 8×8 inch casserole dish.
Put a slice of Swiss cheese on top of each breast.
Spread 1⅓ cups of dry Stove Top stuffing over the cheese.
Spread the cream of chicken soup over the stuffing layer.
Bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, stuffing, Swiss cheese, comfort food

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken
